title: 89,000 AI skills for you to steal
description:
Your agent doesn't need every skill.

It needs the right one now.

Loading everything wastes context.

Searching keeps the window lean.

The MCP finds relevant skills.

Then it pulls full instructions.

Anthropic guides are already included.

Community skills sit beside them.

Like searching a library catalog.

You only carry one book.

Stop rebuilding known workflows.

Search first and move faster.

#mcp #aiskills #anthropic #aiagents #contextwindow
